title: Grateful Dead Live at The Omni on 1973-12-12

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard capture of a late‑1973 show with a standout first Peggy‑O, Jack Straw and an epic Eyes → Morning Dew jam, despite slight speed issues and missing Sugar Magnolia/Casey Jones.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean SBD source that lets the band’s late‑73 energy shine – Jerry is in command, Bob Weir and the keyboards sparkle on Peggy‑O, Playin’ and China>Rider, and the Eyes>Dew sequence is often called the best ever.  A few listeners note the tape runs a tad fast and that Sugar Magnolia and Casey Jones are absent, but overall the performance is highly praised.

ai_rating.rationale: Average rating ~4.44 from 18 reviews, overwhelmingly positive comments on musical performance and soundboard clarity; minor complaints about pitch speed and missing tracks keep the score just below top‑tier.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp SBD with clear mix; a few listeners note a slight fast/pitch issue (tad sharp) and occasional vocal wobble, plus missing tracks and a tape splice.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong late‑73 set with a memorable soundcheck, solid first set highlights (Playin', Me and Bobby), but the second set is missing Sugar Magnolia and Casey Jones in this source.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as 'in control' during soundcheck, guitar tone praised, gives cue to Keith for Peggy‑O; some note his vocals sound slightly high due to tape speed.
band_member_comments.Bob: Shines on Playin', Me and Bobby and contributes strong vocals; highlighted in the soundcheck and early songs.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith (keys) receives a cue from Jerry during Peggy‑O and delivers a standout performance; no comments about other keyboardists.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drum speed noted as faster than later versions, especially on Sugar Magnolia (which is missing).
